metadata.Name: Russian Financial Statements Database
metadata.Description: An open, harmonized collection of annual unconsolidated financial statements for the universe of Russian firms from 2011-2023. It includes data for 56.6 million geolocated firm-year observations, enriched with geolocations, and uniquely includes information on non-filing firms to address reporting bias.
Provider: The Institute for the Rule of Law
Derived From: Uniform State Register of Legal Entities (EGRUL)
Federal State Statistics Service of Russia (Rosstat)
Federal Tax Service of Russia (FNS) GIR BO
Registers of Professional Participants of Financial Market
Register of Firms on Financial Market
metadata.Paper Title: Russian Financial Statements Database: A firm-level collection of the universe of financial statements
Affiliations: European University at Saint Petersburg, The Institute for the Rule of Law, Saint Petersburg, 191187, Russia
metadata.Abstract: The Russian Financial Statements Database (RFSD) is an open, harmonized collection of annual unconsolidated financial statements of the universe of Russian firms in 2011--2023. It is the first open data set with information on every active firm in the country, including non-filing firms. With 56.6 million geolocated firm-year observations gathered from two official sources, the RFSD features multiple end-user quality-of-life improvements such as data imputation, statement articulation, harmonization across data providers and formats, and data enrichment. Extensive internal and external validation shows that most statements articulate well while their aggregates display higher correlation with the regional GDP than the previous gridded GDP data products. We also examine the direction and magnitude of the reporting bias by comparing the universe of firms that are required to file with the actual filers. The RFSD can be used in various economic applications as diverse as calibration of micro-founded models, estimation of markups and productivity, or assessing industry organization and market power.
